subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the current explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and merged policy require explicit selection for key-free managed web_search providers, while the requested change affects outbound provider routing and user consent defaults.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the current runtime guard and solve confusion through diagnostics, setup guidance, or Doctor/configure messaging for enabled-but-unselected keyless providers.

options.title: Approve implicit keyless fallback
options.body: Allow keyless fallback only with aligned runtime metadata, setup behavior, docs, tests, and real behavior proof in the linked PR or a maintainer-sponsored replacement.

options.title: Pause or close the candidate PR
options.body: Leave the issue open as policy context while closing the implementation branch if maintainers do not want implicit keyless external routing.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the current runtime guard and solve confusion through diagnostics, setup guidance, or Doctor/configure messaging for enabled-but-unselected keyless providers.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy this issue asks to reverse.
